raids.raidLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Living Wire, Murkcap, Drum-Belly, Hushpuppy, White Noise) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

raids.beatLine: 🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Focus Group came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.
